items.title: Håkan Rydin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Glasgow, Scotland, July 27, 2016
items.q: I think I never heard it in jazz circles.

ctx.x: And you went from that, I was taking notes, and you picked the tempo up and then you were playing this other song and I’m going what is that song. And was I wrong or was it “Where Have All the Flowers Gone”?
You are so correct. Yes. I think I forgot to mention it. But I said I’ve got to play something which I heard when I grew up. Yeah. It’s from Pete Seeger. I think I never heard it in jazz circles.
